title: ISic004517. Mason's mark (pi) from the Ionic temple at Syracuse
body:
Text encoding: Valentina Mignosa

Facsimile Images

Apparatus criticus

  • 1: Text after Guzzardi 2012, 174 n. 61.

English translation

Valentina Mignosa

Pi-shaped mark.

commentary

Guzzardi records this sign, resembling Greek pi, on one of two further blocks in the same masonry structure within the perimeter of the cella as the block bearing the sigma-shaped mark. The publication supplies neither an illustration nor measurements of the individual block. Its context places it within the same construction phase, dated to the late sixth or early fifth century BCE. Comparable signs on blocks from the temple are interpreted as setting-out marks used to guide their positioning and orientation.

bibliography

  • Guzzardi 2012 150; 174 n. 61

The incised sign resembles the Greek letter pi.
